info.title: FamilyOS API
info.description: The API connected apps use. Generated from what the extensions offer; do not edit. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (a key from Settings, Connected apps); add `X-FamilyOS-On-Behalf-Of: <member id>` to act for a member the app may act for. Every answer carries the family `timeZone`, instants are RFC 3339 with an offset and days are `YYYY-MM-DD`. Within v1 operations and fields are only added.

reason.description: With `forbidden`: `capability` (the role lacks it), `approval`, `critical`, `on_behalf` (the app may not act for that member)

currentVersion.description: With `precondition_failed`: the version the thing has now

ErrorCode.description: `bad_request` (400): the request is wrong, see `fields`. `unauthenticated` (401): no valid key. `forbidden` (403): the key’s role, or the member it acts for, may not. `not_found` (404). `conflict` (409). `idempotency_mismatch` (422): the Idempotency-Key was used for another request. `precondition_failed` (412): the thing changed since the `If-Match` version. `gone` (410): the changes since that cursor are no longer kept. `limit_reached` (429). `feature_off` (404): the extension is switched off. `unavailable` (503). `internal` (500).
